title: test-utils: build_dispatcher called with wrong arity in 4 test files
description: harness.rs lines 208 and 233, e2e.rs lines 47 and 1162, group_and_receipt.rs line 484, and peer_attachment_fetch.rs lines 171, 194, and 211 all call kithd::build_dispatcher with one argument (store only). The production signature requires two: build_dispatcher(store: Arc<Mutex<Store>>, blob_store: Arc<BlobStore>). This is a compile-time failure under --features test-utils, leaving the entire integration test suite broken. Fix: pass a make_blob_store() value as the second argument at each call site, matching the pattern already used in static_files_test.rs.
